assumption: Chris can safely serve people in acute life disruption within a clear non-clinical role
counter_evidence_or_gap: No reviewed scope; no screening/referral/supervision system; common presentations may exceed competence
next_test: Five expert reviews of role map and risk flow
decision_threshold: Proceed only if experts agree a workable scope and prerequisites can be met

assumption: Separation/divorce is the best first discovery beachhead
evidence_for: 102678 divorces in England and Wales in 2023; visible mixed emotional/practical jobs; reachable communities and referrers
counter_evidence_or_gap: No interviews; public posters are self-selected; legal/clinical needs may dominate
next_test: 20-25 recent separation interviews plus 8-10 redundancy comparisons
decision_threshold: Keep primary if a repeated urgent job and reachable safe subsegment outperform the backup

assumption: People want emotional containment and practical action from the same person
evidence_for: Founder anecdote; public coaching offers blend emotional and practical themes
counter_evidence_or_gap: Customers may prefer separate accredited specialists; category may be confusing
next_test: Episode interviews and integrated-versus-separate role-card test
decision_threshold: At least half of relevant interviewees independently prefer or strongly value integration

assumption: Appropriate clients will trust Chris enough to disclose and act
evidence_for: Personal evidence of unusual disclosure and emotional safety
counter_evidence_or_gap: No client sample; trust may depend on credentials lived experience gender referral or title
next_test: Blind profile tests; referral-source interviews; bounded pilot feedback
decision_threshold: Clear trust signals and no recurring disqualifying objection in the target segment

assumption: The service produces useful durable improvement beyond natural recovery
evidence_for: One illustrative relocation conversation; heterogeneous adjacent intervention evidence
counter_evidence_or_gap: No ELS outcomes baseline follow-up or comparison
next_test: Client-defined outcomes with baseline milestone exit and follow-up in pilot
decision_threshold: Most eligible pilot clients improve on agreed outcomes without serious adverse or dependency signals

assumption: High-touch support can increase agency without dependency
evidence_for: Agency is an explicit design principle
counter_evidence_or_gap: Ongoing access and founder economics can reward dependence
next_test: Access limits; step-down reviews; dependency questions; adverse-effect log
decision_threshold: No serious dependency pattern and evidence of increased independent navigation

assumption: A viable group will pay enough for the offer
evidence_for: Adjacent public offers reach GBP800 monthly and GBP995 per package; concierge retainers exceed GBP1000
counter_evidence_or_gap: List prices are not sales evidence; many alternatives are free or cheaper
next_test: Past-spend interviews then refundable deposits and two paid pilot options
decision_threshold: Behavioural commitment at a price that covers bounded delivery without selecting for unsafe distress

assumption: Four or five clients form a sustainable workload
evidence_for: Illustrative bounded model gives 56 monthly delivery hours for four clients
counter_evidence_or_gap: High-access version reaches 88 hours before sales research leave and general admin
next_test: Two-week service simulation and detailed time log
decision_threshold: Delivery remains below the agreed capacity ceiling with viable effective hourly margin

assumption: Emotional Life Support is a trusted and safe brand name
counter_evidence_or_gap: May imply medicine emergency constant availability or dependency; exact phrase is not an established category
next_test: Unprompted comprehension and association testing with at least 20 target participants
decision_threshold: At least 80 percent understand non-clinical support after a descriptor and crisis/dependency misread is rare

assumption: High-touch learning will reveal repeatable scalable elements
evidence_for: The proposed process contains codable steps
counter_evidence_or_gap: Value may depend on Chris's personal presence and judgement
next_test: Structured intervention-context-outcome coding and one repeated element test
decision_threshold: Same element is useful across multiple appropriate cases without reduced safety or agency
